text_overrides.ordinary_2: Can't complain. There's always work to do in the fields.
text_overrides.ordinary_3: I'm all right. Taking things as they come.
text_overrides.content_2: Doing well. I like watching the crops come along.
text_overrides.content_3: In a good mood. Nice to have some company.
text_overrides.stressed_1: Too many things to worry about just now.
text_overrides.stressed_2: I've got a lot on my mind.
text_overrides.stressed_3: A bit worn out, if I'm honest.
